name: Photography classes
summary: How expats join photography classes in Singapore — phone vs mirrorless beginner tracks, weekend walkabouts, and studio lighting intros.
body:
Photography schools and indie coaches run beginner phone courses, mirrorless fundamentals, and genre workshops (street, family, food). Walkabout lessons use MRT-accessible neighbourhoods; studio sessions cost more but teach light control.

## Formats
- Phone photography intensives
- Mirrorless / DSLR fundamentals
- Weekend outdoor walkabouts
- Family / newborn posing intros
- Lighting studio short courses

Clarify whether camera hire is included.

## How to choose
Prefer teachers who critique a small homework set, not only lecture settings. Ask about class size and rain plans for outdoor sessions. Confirm editing software expectations.

## Practical tip
Bring one SD card and a charged battery, not your whole kit. First classes are about seeing light, not swapping lenses every five minutes.
